name: multi_ema_ribbon_squeeze_5s
author: adapted from Gemini Quant
thesis: Exploits the 'spring-loading' of multi-timeframe averages. When EMA(9, 21, 50) all cluster within a 0.1% range, the market is in equilibrium. The subsequent expansion usually signifies a strong trend initiation as various timeframe traders (scalpers to day-traders) all align in the same direction.
mechanism: An EMA ribbon (multiple EMAs of different periods) provides a visual representation of trend strength and momentum. When all EMAs are aligned and fanned out, institutional flow is consistently one-directional across multiple timeframes. Convergence of the ribbon signals flow exhaustion and a potential reversal as the dominant participants complete their orders.

indicators.name: squeeze
indicators.formula: max(ema_9, ema_21, ema_50) / min(ema_9, ema_21, ema_50) < 1.001

weaknesses: Ribbons can remain squeezed for hours
adaptation_notes: Converted from 1min to 5s bars. Lookback multiplier: 12x. Adaptations: timeframe scaling to 5-second candles; signal conversion from individual stock to NIFTY/BANKNIFTY index; lookback period scaling for 5-second bars. Stop/target calibrated for options point-based exits. Universe narrowed to NIFTY index.
